# 🏥 ML.NET Repository Health Dashboard — 2026-03-04

**Overall:** 🔴 Needs Attention
**Status:** 🔴 3 critical · 🟡 5 warnings · 🔵 2 info

> This is the first health check for the dotnet/machinelearning repository. The repository shows significant backlog in issue triage and community engagement. There are 211 untriaged issues requiring classification, 5 community PRs without any reviews (some over 3 years old), and 52 unanswered questions. However, CI health is good with 100% GitHub Actions success rate over the past 7 days.

---

## 🚨 Maintainer Action Required

### Immediate (🔴 Critical)

- **211 untriaged issues** — Far exceeds healthy threshold of 50. Many recent submissions need classification and assignment. [View untriaged issues](https://github.com/dotnet/machinelearning/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Auntriaged)
  - Recent: [#7581](https://github.com/dotnet/machinelearning/issues/7581) TreeEnsembleRegressor is deprecated in ONNX (17 days old)
  - [#7577](https://github.com/dotnet/machinelearning/issues/7577) Add Melt method (24 days old)
  - [#7574](https://github.com/dotnet/machinelearning/issues/7574) Add CountDistinct method to GroupBy (33 days old)
  - [#7568](https://github.com/dotnet/machinelearning/issues/7568) erfInv is very inefficient (48 days old)

- **5 community PRs with no reviews** — Contributors are waiting for feedback, some for over 1,000 days:
  - [#6449](https://github.com/dotnet/machinelearning/pull/6449) Add DataViewSchema overloads to ConvertToOnnx — **1,207 days old** 🚨
  - [#7094](https://github.com/dotnet/machinelearning/pull/7094) Add support for Apache.Arrow.Types.Decimal128Type — **713 days old** 🚨
  - [#7569](https://github.com/dotnet/machinelearning/pull/7569) fix: performance of erfinv — 48 days old
  - [#7575](https://github.com/dotnet/machinelearning/pull/7575) Add CountDistinct and CountIf methods to GroupBy — 32 days old
  - [#7578](https://github.com/dotnet/machinelearning/pull/7578) Add Melt method to DataFrame — 23 days old

- **P0 Issue Open** — [#5805](https://github.com/dotnet/machinelearning/issues/5805) MKLImports PDB not included with packages (1,747 days old)
  - Priority: P0 (Critical)
  - No recent activity since 2021

### Timely (🟡 Warning)

- **52 unanswered questions >7 days old** — Many community members waiting for guidance. [View questions](https://github.com/dotnet/machinelearning/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Aquestion+sort%3Acreated-asc)
  - Oldest: [#181](https://github.com/dotnet/machinelearning/issues/181) Reinforcement learning (3,175 days old)
  - Many questions from 2017-2020 have never received maintainer responses

- **6 stale PRs >90 days old** — Long-pending reviews may indicate unclear ownership or decision paralysis

- **4 issues awaiting user input** — Should verify if users have responded:
  - [#7174](https://github.com/dotnet/machinelearning/issues/7174) Add AutoEncoder as Feature Selection Method (last comment by user Feb 24, 2025)
  - [#6045](https://github.com/dotnet/machinelearning/issues/6045) Long Column names unexpectedly dropped in training
  - [#6034](https://github.com/dotnet/machinelearning/issues/6034) Crashing in UWP Release, but not in Debug
  - [#5779](https://github.com/dotnet/machinelearning/issues/5779) object detection output float32[None,None2,13,13]

- **1 open security issue** — [#3604](https://github.com/dotnet/machinelearning/issues/3604) Ensure documentation warns that models should be treated as code from security point of view (P3, 2,499 days old)

---

## 💡 Recommendations

1. **Establish triage rotation** — With 211 untriaged issues, implement a weekly triage rotation among maintainers to classify and label incoming issues. Set a team goal to keep untriaged under 20.

2. **Community PR review sprint** — Dedicate time to review the 5 outstanding community PRs, especially #6449 (1,207 days old) and #7094 (713 days old). Either merge, request changes, or close with explanation.

3. **Close stale questions with guidance** — Many unanswered questions from 2017-2020 may no longer be relevant. Review and close with pointers to updated documentation or suggest reopening if still applicable.

4. **Address P0 issue #5805** — The MKLImports PDB issue has been open for nearly 5 years. Either resolve it or downgrade priority if it's no longer critical.

5. **Automate "awaiting user input" cleanup** — Consider a bot that automatically closes issues labeled "Awaiting User Input" with no response after 60-90 days.

---

## 🔍 Correlation Insights

- **High untriaged count + many old unanswered questions** suggests a maintainer bandwidth issue or triage process gap. The project may benefit from additional maintainers or community triage volunteers.

- **5 community PRs with zero reviews (some >1000 days old)** indicates a critical community engagement problem. This can discourage future contributions and harm the project's reputation.

- **100% CI success rate but low PR merge activity** — CI is healthy, but low merge velocity (0 PRs merged in 7 days) may indicate decision paralysis or lack of active development.

- **Very old P0 and security issues** — Issues labeled P0 and Security remaining open for years suggests either mislabeling or insufficient prioritization of critical work.

- **Low activity across all metrics (0 issues opened/closed, 0 PRs merged in 7 days)** — May indicate the repository is in maintenance mode or experiencing low maintainer bandwidth.
